    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AppLog
     
    ControlPanel
    Controller class for the JavaFX UI that manages simulation control panel, including play/pause, traffic light control, vehicle injection, filtering, and data export functionality.
    DataType
    Containing basic classes, methods to convert datatype and static variables
    DataType.EdgeData
    basic edge data class
    DataType.Identifiable
    Interface for obejct with id
    DataType.RouteData
    basic route data class
    DataType.RouteNotFoundException
    Exception when input route does not exist
    DataType.TrafficLightData
    basic traffic light data class
    DataType.VehicleData
    basic vehicle data class
    DataType.VehicleExistedException
    Exception when trying to inject a new vehicle with existing ID
    Graph
    Manages statistical charts for the simulation (average speed, travel time, density).
    MapCanvas
    Manages the canvas for rendering the SUMO network map, vehicles, traffic lights, and routes.
    Networkpaser
    Parses SUMO network XML files to extract road network data including junctions, edges, and lanes.
    Networkpaser.Edge
    Represents a road edge connecting two junctions, containing one or more lanes.
    Networkpaser.Junction
    Represents a junction (intersection) in the road network with position, type, and shape information.
    Networkpaser.Lane
    Represents a traffic lane within an edge, including geometric shape, speed limit, and physical dimensions.
    Networkpaser.MidLine
    Represents a calculated midline between two opposite directional edges, used for rendering center lane markings.
    Networkpaser.NetworkModel
    Container class holding the complete parsed network data including all edges, junctions, midlines, and bounding box coordinates for the entire network.
    SimulationWrapper
    Wapper of the Sumo Simulation
    Statistic
    Class mainly for tracking simulation data
    Transform
    Manages coordinate transformations between world coordinates and screen coordinates.
    View
    Manages view transformations including zoom, pan, and coordinate system for the map canvas.
